## Package review

- Package ID:
- Dataset version:

### Automated gates

- [ ] `npm run data:registry:build`
- [ ] `npm run data:validate`
- [ ] Query ledger row accounting, checksums, scope, and limitations are current
- [ ] Every visible factual field maps to a claim and supporting reference
- [ ] English and Chinese coverage is complete

### Scientific review

- [ ] Reviewer identity and date are recorded
- [ ] Claim locators were checked against the cited sources
- [ ] Competing interpretations and uncertainty are represented
- [ ] The decision applies to the dataset version above
- [ ] No generated scaffold is being presented as expert-reviewed

### Rights and release

- [ ] Source licenses and media rights were checked
- [ ] Changelog and migration notes are included
- [ ] Static page and Explorer deep links were smoke-tested
